task.title: Troubleshoot failed startup and unreachable probes
task.shortdesc: Diagnose a source-run BPM process that does not start or does not answer health and readiness probes.

prereq.p: Use this procedure when make dev, uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000, GET /health, or GET /health/ready fails during source deployment or integration startup.

context.p: This diagnostic keeps process, environment, and probe evidence separate. It does not create a systemd unit, Windows service, reverse proxy, TLS endpoint, or production restart policy.

step.cmd: Capture the failing command and foreground log.

info.p: Run or copy the exact command, then record stdout and stderr from the foreground terminal. Include make dev, uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000, Python traceback summary, working directory, and source revision from git rev-parse --short HEAD.

step.cmd: Verify the configured host and port before changing the deployment.

info.p: Check BPM_HOST, BPM_PORT, BPM_RELOAD, BPM_DATABASE_URL, and BPM_DOCUMENTATION_SITE_DIR. Recheck http://127.0.0.1:8000/health and http://127.0.0.1:8000/health/ready after correcting a configuration value.

step.cmd: Separate process startup from probe reachability.

info.p: If the process is not running, fix dependency, environment, or migration evidence first. If the process is running but probes are unreachable, check local firewall, bind address, WSL port forwarding, and whether the request targets 127.0.0.1, 0.0.0.0, or a Windows host route.

step.cmd: Preserve user data while collecting evidence.

info.p: Copy logs, environment variable names, and probe responses only. Do not edit the database, schema cache, or deployment files as routine recovery. Do not delete data/bpm.db to make startup pass.

step.cmd: Stop dependent integrations and escalate when probes remain unreachable.

info.note: If probes remain unreachable after configuration and process checks, stop automated integration runs and escalate to the BPM deployment owner with the command, logs, configuration names, and probe evidence.

result.p: The operator can distinguish a failed process, an unreachable probe, and a deployment boundary without mutating user data.

postreq.p: After probes pass, return to the health-gated startup or reusable API examples topic before running mutating integrations.
